# Machine-inspired sufficient transformations

This note records constructive transformations with exact applicability tests. It does not claim an achieved kappa improvement from the three bounded pilot screens below. The source provenance and current evidence level are in COMPLEX-SOURCE-HASHES.json.

## 1. Fused restoration return or entry

Suppose a complete normalized invocation has arbitrary-dirt endpoint (data transformation D, helper operator S on a whole owner, identity on spectators). Suppose S and all final monomial normalizers act inside a fixed local9-coordinate factor. Let Q be a product of C_v on orthogonal pending axes outside this full local9 factor.

If a helper's final recursive child C_r occurs after its last scalar observation or update, replace that child by C_(r+q) on its r coordinates and q of these additional axes, using an explicit full owner chart. No later scalar observation can expose the extra factor. The resulting complete invocation endpoint is (D,Q S), so remove exactly those q axes from its later idle remainder. The exact paid-profile replacement is -[r]-[q]+[r+q]. The larger child must satisfy the existing halving and compiler conditions; all new routing is billed.

There is an entry version: if the selected child occurs before the helper's first scalar observation/update, insert Q at the beginning of the complete invocation, then commute it through the untouched prefix to the selected child. The arbitrary-dirt endpoint theorem makes the data output independent of this changed initial helper value; S Q=Q S gives the same completed pending factor. Initial normalizers must preserve the exterior factor. This is the matrix analogue of an AgreeOutside frame invariant and a fused machine return/entry.

The pilot checks actual emitted scalar operands, not nominal labels. In the current coordinated rank2 word, all 560 helpers are observed in the frame-zero dirty precondition and updated/read again in FULL cleanup. Both prologue and epilogue inventories are empty in both orientations. Do not manufacture a positive tail from the endpoint formula alone. A follow-up must first change compensation/cleanup, prove the same all-column endpoint, and then reprice the complete global profile.

## 2. Deferred normalization with a finite residue ledger

For C_v=((1+i)I+(1-i)X_v)/2, direct expansion gives C_v^2=X_v and C_v^4=I. Allow several different complete invocations to borrow the same pending axis of one whole owner. Let k_v be its actual multiplicity. Choose e_v in {0,1} so k_v+e_v is odd, execute C_v only on the missing-parity axes e_v=1, and emit X_v^((1-k_v-e_v)/2). The final product is exactly C_v. All factors commute, and the sign of the translation exponent is immaterial modulo2.

Every invocation must still use distinct whole owners, complete before the next begins, restore spectators, and occur inside the physical idle interval. Use actual pending vectors, not different charts' coincident coordinate indices. Emit an explicit chart for the possibly noncontiguous remainder and charge the final translation. This is a reversible-machine deferred-normalization invariant; it is not permission to split one residual among owners.

Repeated use does not automatically save rank: it can reduce odd-parity coverage and increase the final remainder. The hosting lane's early paid screen selected disjoint use on the current stock. No numerical gain is assigned here. The rule remains a sufficient way to compile a future positively priced overlapping assignment.

## 3. Recursive common-subexpression substitution

At a proposed recursive call sending a register from frame E to F, suppose a simultaneously live register already equals the same exact logical linear form at frame F on every independent input column. Then a proved copy/scale sequence can supply that output instead of executing the recursive call. Its old value may be overwritten only under the exact reachable-state relation; all private copies must later be cleared correctly. Equality of frame labels alone, equality on test inputs, or equality of response columns without dirty columns is insufficient.

This is a machine checkpoint/common-subexpression rule, with the same matrix-substitution and actual-weight accounting structure as OpenAI WordScheduling. The pilot compares exact rational logical rows and frames at all 3,635 positive recursive sites in each orientation of the existing provider. It finds zero exact matches. This does not rule out proportional forms, a redesigned checkpoint schedule, or a changed provider. A positive follow-up must emit the copy/erase path and pass the all-column physical audit before any saved child is credited.

## What the library reuse establishes

P18's transport/restoration lemmas explain exactly which machine state can be forgotten and which memory must be preserved. Anthropic's AgreeOutside rule provides the footprint criterion. OpenAI's explicit machine-run composition and word substitution explain how to compose complete endpoints and charge the actual replacement. None of these imported source statements by itself proves a new multiplication bound. The mathematical specializations above must be applied to an actual construction and pass the full paid-profile gate.
